data.name: Hotel Safi Centro
data.address: Av. Pino Suárez 444 Sur, Centro, 64000 Monterrey, N.L., Mexico
data.description:
A 2-minute walk from the nearest metro station, this polished hotel is 2 km from both the Museo De Arte Contemporaneo De Monterrey, and the Mexican History Museum.
Warmly decorated rooms and suites offer free Wi-Fi and cable TV, as well as sitting areas, and tea and coffeemakers. Suites add separate living rooms, pull-out sofas and whirlpool tubs. Room service is offered 24/7.
Breakfast is available for a fee, and served in an international restaurant. Other amenities include a bar, an outdoor pool and a hot tub, plus a fitness center, gardens and event space. Parking is available.
